text:
maria: Quick heads-up — I'm opening a small change to the telemetry pipeline to add token_cost and latency.source tags. PR: #7123
pranav: Who's owning the schema migration and the consumer notifications?
ingrid: @maria and I paired on the schema draft yesterday. Ownership: eng-platform (ingrid) for the format, analytics for rollout + dashboards.
maria: Plan outline: 1) publish schema v2 to registry 2) feature-flag ingest logic to accept v2 3) run backfill mapping job 4) flip flag after smoke checks. Tentative deploy window: Thu 13:00 PT.
jon: Any deps on infra quotas or batch windows? I can reserve capacity but need times.
alex: Nightly backfill currently runs 02:00 UTC, compaction at 03:00 UTC. We should keep a 30m cushion, so the 13:00 PT deploy looks fine.
pranav: Token-cost attribution also needs per-route granularity. Proposal: add route_id to event.payload (adds ~6 bytes avg). Is everyone ok with the size impact?
ingrid: Ran a quick estimate — +6B/event raises egress by ~0.02% at current QPS. Acceptable.
maria: CI: PR 7123 passes unit tests locally but analytics-contract CI is flaky. @analytics-sumobot can you re-run the contract job?
analytics-sumobot: Re-run queued by @maria — started.
pranav: I'll take CR after CI is green. Quick pass only (schema + mapping).
jon: Need a small sample for the latency.breakdown shape. Suggest keys: dns, tcp, ssl, ttfb, compute. Example:
```
latency: {dns: 2, tcp: 3, ssl: 5, ttfb: 10, compute: 18}
```
maria: Added that example to the PR description and mapping tests. Also adding a realtime smoke check for the top routes to validate cache prefixing.
ingrid: Rollout canary: 2% traffic for 1 hour. Monitor: token_cost delta (per-route top10) and latency P95. Abort criteria: cost_delta > 10% or P95 increase > 50ms.
sarah-billing: ACK. We'll set an alert to cost_delta > 8% to be conservative and ping pager if hit.
jon: Any blockers left?
alex: Infra quota request was approved — no blocker.
maria: Final ask: if CR + analytics CI are green by EOD I'll schedule the deploy for Thu. Otherwise move to next Tue. :thumbsup:
pranav: ack
ingrid: ack
deploy-bot: scheduled canary job for Thu 13:00 PT (ID: canary-1765439999-7123)
maria: Thanks all — I'll post a short runbook and rollback steps in the doc once PR merges.
